title: To-dos
summary: Read, count, compare, and manage non-temporal personal to-dos and their named groups, including optional contact connections and links to content-library items. Calendar events own schedules and deadlines and may link to multiple to-dos.

batch.reason: Group creation resolves one case-insensitive name uniqueness and reactivation decision.

delete.note: Delete archives an empty or terminal-only group after complete-batch validation.

batch.reason: Creation assigns one exact group position and optional contact connection as one ordered mutation.

delete.note: Delete is the retained archive lifecycle status.

resources.title: To-do content
resources.summary: A direct association between a personal to-do and a content-library item.

update.reason: This edge has no mutable attributes; link and unlink are its complete lifecycle.

resources.title: To-do correspondence provenance
resources.summary: A source-owned correspondence link retained with a personal to-do.
resources.reason: Correspondence ingestion owns this provenance edge; to-do CRUD must not rewrite imported provider evidence.
